name: GDPval-AA
description: GDPval-AA is an evaluation of AI model performance on economically valuable knowledge work tasks across professional domains including finance, legal, and other sectors. Run independently by Artificial Analysis, it uses Elo scoring to rank models on real-world work task performance.
typical_sota_score: Elo scores vary; top frontier models score highest on economically valuable professional tasks
reputation: Run by Artificial Analysis, an independent AI benchmarking organization; focuses on economic value of AI for professional knowledge work tasks
notes: Artificial Analysis independently operates this benchmark to measure AI model performance on tasks representing economically valuable knowledge work. Distinct from academic benchmarks in focusing on real-world professional utility.
